title: Jacob R. Dent, DDS on Special Needs Dentistry, Desensitization, and Restorative Techniques
html:
Dr. Paul Feuerstein, Editor-in-Chief of Dentistry Today, sits down with Jacob R. Dent, DDS, special needs dentist, professional speaker, and co-founder of the Dental Desensitization Systems kit, for a discussion on improving dental care for patients with intellectual and developmental disabilities (IDD) and dental anxiety.

Dr. Dent shares how sensory sensitivities can affect dental visits and explains how desensitization techniques can help patients become more comfortable with preventive care. He discusses the development of the Dental Desensitization Systems kit, the importance of understanding each patient’s sensory needs, and practical strategies for helping caregivers improve oral hygiene at home.

The conversation also explores minimally invasive dentistry, including silver diamine fluoride (SDF), the SMART restorative technique, and approaches to treating patients who have difficulty tolerating conventional dental procedures. Dr. Dent also explains how Directa’s Ceramir Crown & Bridge cement fits into his restorative workflow, particularly when moisture control and patient cooperation are challenging.

From adapting the dental environment to choosing practical restorative materials, this interview highlights the importance of meeting patients where they are and prioritizing progress over perfection.
